response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS avg_of_avg_signed_amount, AVG(avg_bal) AS avg_of_avg_balance FROM (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400 GROUP BY account_id) t

assumptions.assumption: 'Large' means amount >= 2400, so a transaction of exactly 2400 counts as large.

The per-account average balance uses all large transactions of the account, including those of type VYBER or with a missing type. Only the signed-amount figure excludes those. An account whose large transactions are all of other types still counts toward the balance average but is skipped for the signed-amount average.
The VYBER type is excluded from the signed amount, as the request says other types are left out.
